Use

Move-in and move-out processing have the following enhancements:

e ECSBTIOI1 (IS-U move-in: determine application form)

This enhancement enables you to specify a default value for the application form used for the welcome letter.

e ECSBTIO2 (IS-U move-in: determine budget billing amount)

This enhancement enables you to specify a default value for the budget billing amount.

e ECSBTIO4 (IS-U move-in: determine transfer contract)

This enhancement enables you to specify a default value for the transfer contract.

e EMDKOOOI!1 (IS-U utility contract: include subscreens and check fields)

This enhancement enables you to enter default values in contract fields. When you create a move-in, information about the
installations that have to be allocated to the contract is transferred. The enhancement is run during every PBO (process before
output) on the move-in screen.

e EC500001 (IS-U move-in: determine security deposit amount and reason)

This enhancement enables you to specify a default value for the amount of, and reason for a cash security deposit. It is run during
every PBO (process before output) on the move-in screen.

e ECSBTOO1 (IS-U: move-out - determine default values for Customizing of table TE490A)

This enhancement is used, for example, to assign default data to the application form for the move-out confirmation.

e ECSBTIO3 (IS-U move-in: user-defined checks)

This enhancement is used for checking field values on the move-in screen.

e ECSBTOO2 (IS-U move-out: user-defined checks)

This enhancement is used for checking field values on the move-out screen.

e ECSBTMRI (Indicator used to allocate default values to the Create service notification/order functions)

For more information, see Service Notifications and Orders.

e ECSBTOO1 (IS-U: move-in/move-out — customer-specific messages in the information log (environment log)

This enhancement is used to add user-define messages in the environment log.

Enhancements for the Screen Layout

You can include standard and user-defined fields for the contract account and business partner in direct maintenance. To do this,
